title: Callvale after: alias records in a Route 53 hosted zone
claim: The registrar points the domain to the Route 53 hosted zone, whose alias records send both names to CloudFront.
alt: After: the registrar lists the four name servers of a Route 53 public hosted zone. Alias records for callvale.example and app.callvale.example point to CloudFront, which sends requests to the Application Load Balancer. A health check watches the site and alarms through Amazon SNS.

edges.label: name servers
edges.say: The registrar lists the name servers of the Route 53 hosted zone.
Alias records for callvale.example and app.callvale.example answer with CloudFront addresses.
CloudFront sends requests to the Application Load Balancer.

edges.label: watches
edges.say: A health check watches the site, and its alarm notifies the team through Amazon SNS.

notes: Brief 13 story pair, after; 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Decision). Title, claim, alt, steps from brief.json. Same cells as route53-before. Step facts per brief: route53-faq-external-registrar-must-update-name-servers (1), route53-faq-apex-alias-cloudfront and route53-alias-target-cloudfront (2), route53-health-check-notification-uses-cloudwatch-and-sns (4); step 3 states no AWS rule. No second Region, no AWS WAF. No AWS number in the drawing.
